dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: "When water's natural purity is preserved, disease cannot fester. But when sullied at its source, it gives rise to all manner of plagues and pestilences. Therefore, let the one who pollutes a water source through negligence be shown leniency, but let any that would willfully pollute a water source be shown no mercy whatsoever."

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: In response to the recent pollution of Feiyun Slope's water source, Yujing Terrace has sent someone to urgently deal with it. In a few days, the water will be clean as ever.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: The Millelith hereby remind all who come to fetch water at Chihu Rock to follow the rules and avoid polluting the water.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Violators who break the rules and pollute the water source will be severely punished by the Millelith.

dialogues.text: Exquisite delicacies that cater to all tastes!

dialogues.speaker: Wanmin Restaurant Ad
dialogues.text: An all new flavor that reminds you of the good ol' days!

dialogues.speaker: Wanmin Restaurant Ad
dialogues.text: Wanmin Restaurant awaits your visit!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Is Xiangling in the kitchen today?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Sincerest apologies, but my daughter is out traveling the seven nations of Teyvat studying the culinary arts. It may be some time before she returns."

dialogues.text: Prestigious cooking and a sharp knife!

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp Ad
dialogues.text: A fast blade, roaring fire, and authentic grilled fish!

dialogues.speaker: Chen the Sharp Ad
dialogues.text: If you want to eat the most authentic Grilled Tiger Fish in Liyue, come to Chen the Sharp!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "How's business? Do you have time to reminisce with an old friend of the Guhua Clan?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Certainly, just let me know where! Or you could come by my restaurant — food and drinks on me!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I recently lost a spear that looks similar to that used by the Millelith. I will be immensely grateful if anyone helps me find it!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If you find the spear or have any information as to where it may be, please meet me near the shipyard."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "No matter if you are a Liyue resident or a traveler from afar, I would really appreciate your help."

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Liyue branch of the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: When gazing at the night sky, do you find yourself yearning to reach the stars?

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: When overlooking a perilous abyss, do you find yourself wondering what treasure lies at the bottom?

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Sign up for the Adventurers' Guild! Let's conquer all the world's dangers and uncover all the world's secrets together.

dialogues.speaker: Adventurers' Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Please talk to Katheryne for more information.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'm no good at advertisements, so I just decided to post a note on the message board!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Cheap 'n' tasty Zhongyuan Chop Suey! Fragrant, spicy, and guaranteed to satisfy your taste buds!"

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Reply
dialogues.text: "Dear Madam Su, this is a Bulletin Board for announcements, not messages..."

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Reply
dialogues.text: "To publish ads, please register with the Millelith... and please refrain from posting unrelated messages here."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Sorry to trouble you, boys! Come by for a meal when you're off your shift, I'll give you a discount!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Each day the high and low tides come to shore, each splash of the sea different from the last."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I still sit here watching the waves join and part, thinking of you."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When will you return from some vast sea far away and see this message, my heart poured out for you to see?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "When will we be able to fulfill our promises, made to each other long ago?"

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Reply
dialogues.text: "Please do not post love letters on the Bulletin Board. Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Most mining at the Chasm has been shut down, but illegal mining and smuggling activity has increased recently.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: We urge Liyue residents to take extra caution and cooperate with Millelith soldiers as they work to apprehend the smugglers.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Jade vendors should similarly strictly abide by the law. Heavy fines will be issued to anyone engaging in the sale of smuggled minerals.

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: Life can be as precious as jade if you dig past the rocky exterior. Make acute, quick decisions in life, or you will regret missed opportunities.

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: But while we only live once, we can enjoy the joy of jade many-a-time. Which is more exciting, embarking on a daring adventure or receiving a beautiful piece of jade?

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: Just a small price for a big surprise.

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: Delights and good luck await you at The Jade Mystery!

dialogues.speaker: The Jade Mystery Ad
dialogues.text: A cartload of uncut jade has just arrived. Come by to marvel its beauty, and purchase if so inclined!

dialogues.text: Elegant like jade and delicate like a rose, my wares are a feast for the eyes and pleasure to touch.

dialogues.speaker: Scent of Spring Ad

dialogues.speaker: Scent of Spring Ad
dialogues.text: Have even a wisp of the scent of spring and you will never forget it. You and fine porcelain are perfect for each other.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I officially start as a member of the Millelith tomorrow! Let's drink until the sun rises, everyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My stinkin' father said I'd never become a soldier. Well, look at me now, pops!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Tomorrow morning you are to report for patrol, recruit. Remember there's punishment for failed inspection."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The Millelith need to set an example for our citizens and only post serious announcements on the bulletin board."

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: There has been smuggling activity recently in the area near Bibo's Fish Market. We ask residents to be vigilant and report any suspicious activity to the Millelith.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Furthermore, by order of the Qixing, the Millelith will be increasing license inspection of vendors at Bibo's Fish Market. We ask vendors to prepare their licenses accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Due to popular demand from residents and Millelith alike, a special space at the south wharf has been designated for performances by the up-and-coming Xinyan.

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Announcement
dialogues.text: Enthusiasts of Fontaine music are welcome to come and enjoy, but please maintain order when attending to avoid injuring yourself or others.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Please do not insult my craft! My unique sound belongs to me, not Fontaine!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Who is that fox at the Yanshang Teahouse? Last time I had the misfortune of sharing a table with her I spent all of my money!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I can't stand to even think of those beady fox eyes! I forget that she's the teahouse steward — she acts like a swindler!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "If the fox sees this post, please respond. Just see how arrogant you are when I get my friends to come!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Note
dialogues.text: "Don't worry, your friends are already waiting for you at the dock. (I went ahead and bought some medicine for them. You can pick it up first.)"
